body:
[Erowid Note: This author of this report originally identified the powder below as 'MBDB', with no justifaction as to why. This report is marked as an MDMA report, but readers should be aware that this is more of a general 'Ecstasy' report.]
My friend B and I were having a new years day party at my house when the opportunity to buy some 'pure MDMA powder' arose. Having tried to smoke a small chunk of a red superman unsucessfully a few days prior I jumped at the chance to try again with some pure powder to see if it was either unsmokable at all, or if it could be freebased. When B returned with the powder he warned me of a girl that had recently taken 400mg and felt nothing until she began to vomit. Now, I take all warnings with a grain of salt because I a) don't believe anything I hear and only half of what I see (lol) b) am daring and think a little risk makes life worth living and c) didn't particularly care/associate someone else's malcontent with my own before trying it myself.
Anyway, when I first gazed upon the substance in question, I immediatly had the feeling it was not MDMA but I trusted my source and knew he wouldn't ever sell me caffine pills or some other non-psychoactive placebo, so I set out trying to identify what exactly it was. The color was off-white almost to a beige skin-tone and it smelled strongly of licorice and the taste was not the familliar mdma bitterness. The powder was loose and fluffy and broke appart in large clumps and small crunchy chunks that resembled dry amber.
T+0: B and I both insufflate 2 conservative lines (~100mg a piece) and feel a very strong burn for a few seconds and a quick shiver as the substance settles
T+10min: I notice the buzz coming on very quickly much too quick for MDMA a very happy satisfied feeling with no jaw clenching or stomach/kidney pains
T+15min: B and I are having a nice buzz and talking very freely and having a good time just conversing. We take our friends advice and each dose another 100mg
T+45min: Feels very much like extacy only more relaxed. I feel like I could sleep very easily, although I like the euphoria of extacy so much I could practically sleep on it altough I wouldn't do that because it'd feel like a major waste. Slight uncoordination like being a bit drunk and inhibition of short term memory, things like playing video games become tedious and overly complex, it seems much nicer to sit back and be passive. Definatly not a drug I'd want to plan to accomplish a lot of work on.
~T+1.5hr: B and I are coming down a little from the euphoria
and decide to split a superman
T+2hr: The two chemicals seem to mix together very well, the
powder may have taken away from the euphoria of the
pill but also seems to quell the stomach/kidney pains somewhat
. The
pill  elmininated the slight dis-coordination and memory block as well as gave back  motivation and energy.
I suspect that taking MDMA with MBDB may make the MDMA comedown more irritating but MBDB itself seems to have no residual effects other than a relaxed sense of wellbeing and perhaps lethargy. Personally MBDB is a substance I'd recommend and would enjoy taking every now and then, but not as much as something more powerful like MDMA.
